notes.title: Update and notes from the patch 1.0.3!
notes.content:
Hi there guys, I'm bringing a new patch for all of you! 

[list]
    [*]Tweaks on Challenge Speeds.
    [*]Adjustments to some challenge blocks.
    [*]Added more worker drop ratio!
 [*]Fixed some translation mistakes.
[/list]

Hope you all enjoy the game, and as always! see you around guys!

-Rob

notes.title: Update and notes from the patch 1.0.2!
notes.content:
This update contains a new help system that will give you some pro tips everytime you die! 

[list]
    [*]Some tweaks on the UI
    [*]New help system (Game Over Screen)
    [*]Some extra fixes to random blocks and optimizations.
[/list]


Thank you all for the feedback! 

Enjoy the game! 

-Rob

notes.title: Update and notes from the patch 1.0.1!
notes.content:
Hi there guys, it's been a crazy launch, a few of you reported some bugs that now are fixed (a gazillion thanks for that)! 

Here is the list with the changes!
[list]
[*]Now the game allows you to move it around screens.
[*]New option to make it fullscreen or disable it.
[*]Boss fight fixes including crazy physics behaviour with some hanging blocks!
[*]Extra tweaks to some blocks.
[*]Translation lines missing.
[*]Missing executable on Mac and Linux
[/list]

*if you find any new bug or you just have a suggestion let us know, we actually want to know your oppinion! 

Apologies for any inconveniences caused!
Hope you all enjoy the game! 

See you around!
(If the game doesn't update automatically just restart Steam!)

Rob
